slides.h1: Panic-Selling on a Bad Week? Meet Moon Bias
slides.sub: A behavioural pattern, not a market call.

slides.body: In Jyotish the Moon signifies the mind and emotion. A Moon-heavy money pattern means decisions swing with how you feel that week.
Check the 2nd house (wealth, savings) and the 11th (gains) with the Moon's sign, house and aspects. An unsettled Moon there hints at this pattern.

points: Write rules before the week gets emotional
Wait 48 hours before any big move

slides.body: No yoga guarantees wealth. This is a self-awareness tool about habits. It is not financial advice or a stock pick.
Free AI chart reading: see your 2nd and 11th house patterns.
